body.heading: Comfort is not the opposite of effort
paragraphs: There is a stubborn idea that comfort is laziness in disguise. In reality, people work, learn and care better when they are not running on empty, and small comforts are one of the ways tanks get refilled.
The key word is 'chosen'. A comfort you select and savour feels different from one you fall into and barely notice.

body.heading: Build a short list of yours
paragraphs: Write down five small comforts that reliably work for you: a particular mug, a song, a sunny seat, a stretch, a chapter of a favourite book. Keep the list somewhere visible for flat days, when choosing is hardest.

Then practise doing one thing at a time. Drink the tea while drinking the tea, not while answering messages. A comfort given your full attention for five minutes restores more than an hour of distracted half-rest.

takeaway: Choose your small comforts deliberately, and give one your full attention today.
